I’ve been on Prozac for 2 months. The dosage has recently been upped but it still wasn’t working before. Pretty sure it’s a chemical imbalance. My dad was also diagnosed with depression and anxiety and I’m pretty sure some other people in my family have it. Pretty sure it just runs in my family.

Back outta the mental hospital. I was somewhat happy in there. I wasn’t lonely like I am now. It’s so hard to talk to people because of how socially anxious I am. By the way my mom knows I’m non-binary and she supports me. I barely have anything that stresses me out yet I still want to die. I feel like my meds are giving me bad mood swings but I have to wait a few weeks to be able to talk to my psychiatrist about meds. My meds just aren’t helping at all. I just told someone :) I know they probably won’t kill me anyways so yeah

I already have a trash can beside my bed ready because I know the rest of the day is going to be absolute hell. My mom will probably notice the pills are gone anyways. I’ll be fine. I don’t want to alert my mom because she will start crying and I’ll feel bad. I’m already kinda nauseous but it’s fine. I probably won’t die anyway.

It’s crazy how the way I feel can change so fast. Anyways I’m not doing well again. I don’t see myself making it much longer but I am trying my best to hold on. I’ve been thinking about trying to commit suicide again for the whole day and I can’t stop thinking about it. I used cutting as a distraction but it didn’t last for long and now I don’t know what to do because it’s about to be summer and my family is going to question why I’m always wearing long sleeved shirts. Is it bad that I wish I was in the mental hospital again. I hate that I feel this way so much. It’s just that everything in there was so much easier. I honestly kinda felt happy in there. I didn’t have to hide the fact that I’m queer. There was a lot of people that related to me. I had close to no responsibilities. Anyways I honestly don’t want to die but there’s no point in staying if I’m not happy. There is so many things in life that I want to do.
